title: Responsive Operator Shell, Touch Targets & Device Layout Recovery
checkpoints: menu closed by default at phone/tablet width; open, close and Escape return keyboard focus
on orientation or desktop-width recovery the menu closes and the current workspace is unchanged
business context, navigation search, theme density and theme contrast survive reflow
primary actions remain accessible with minimum 44px touch height at phone/tablet sizes
evidence-table overflow stays within its card, without clipping action buttons
phone status source and reason labels stay visible rather than being suppressed
400% zoom supports vertical document flow and readable focus targets
none of the responsive controls enable calls, SMS, dispatch, databases or six-app connections
evidencePolicy: Code and jsdom matrix checks are not photographic/browser or real owner-device acceptance. Record actual widths, platform, OS, browser, screenshot, keyboard/touch observation and reviewer before closing these checkpoints.
